headline: Last session: Sensex fell 289 points while Nifty slipped due to inflation concerns weighing on markets

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 16 November.

why: Inflation concerns weighed on sentiment during Friday's trading session.
Foreign fund inflows and lower crude oil prices supported early trade gains during the week.
NIFTY50 and SENSEX extended their rally for the third consecutive week.
PSU Banks emerged as the top sectoral gainers in the weekly wrap.
whatHappening: Sensex dropped 289 points and Nifty slipped in the last session.
CMS Info reported a 10% rise in Q2 profit as services revenue reached a record for the fourth straight quarter.
NADT and NISM signed an MoU to train Income Tax officials in securities markets.
Bengaluru Metro Pink Line opened with details released on route, stations, timings, and fares.
summary:
In the last session, Sensex fell 289 points and Nifty slipped as inflation concerns weighed on market sentiment.
Despite the decline, benchmark indices SENSEX and NIFTY50 extended their weekly rally for the third straight week with PSU Banks leading gains.
Corporate updates saw CMS Info report a 10% rise in Q2 net profit alongside record quarterly services revenue.
